cases.purpose: External SIGINT exits the live loop and restores the original PTY settings.
cases.oracle: Independent PTY controller snapshots termios, waits for raw rendering, sends the signal and verifies exit and exact restoration.
cases.comparison: Process exit and exact pre/post termios, with bounded setup and cleanup.
